name: Nutun Limited
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from Nutun Limited unaudited condensed consolidated income statement, six months ended 31 March 2026, unit R million stored in absolute ZAR. Revenue 711 and cost of revenue 385 give the printed gross profit from the provision of services of 326. Operating expenses are an honest dash: the printed operating loss of 79 also carries net income from purchased book debts 69, imputed interest revenue 383, interest expense 177, an impairment loss on principal book portfolios 167, fair value movements 30 and a net finance charge of 39, so the ten row chain cannot be rebuilt from one expense cell. Net finance costs 39 is the printed net finance charge. Profit before tax (92) less the printed tax credit 29 (stored negative) equals the printed loss for the period of (63); there were no discontinued operations in H1 2026. EPS is the printed basic loss per share of 8.1 cents converted to rand. rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys NTU and NTU.JO are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. The figure backed by the issuer's own filing () is served there; this key's conflicting figure is removed so one issuer does not carry two.
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
